title: For, remember, the fire of hell gives forth no light. As, at the command of God, the fire of the Babylonian furnace lost its heat but not its light
html_source: Referring to Chapters 1 through 3 of the Book of Daniel, where three men were thrown into a furnace for opposing Nebuchadnezzar II, but were unharmed. The fires maintained their light but were without heat.

anchor.text: For, remember, the fire of hell gives forth no light. As, at the command of God, the fire of the Babylonian furnace lost its heat but not its light
